decisions.reason: As a simple accessory closely linked to the firm's trailer and after-sales know-how, it remains easy to support and improve, though its limited strategic weight makes it more droppable than the core trailer lines.

This box car trailer series fits directly with the firm's core manufacturing, sales, and service capabilities, and several years of market presence would normally strengthen learning and commitment rather than favor withdrawal.

The high trailer cover series builds on existing trailer platforms and accessory channels, so the firm can readily absorb user feedback and refine it, with only a modest withdrawal risk from portfolio simplification.
